notes:
POC focused on Dedicated capacity & SLA terms. Primary ask: throughput guarantee for peak market windows and p95 latency SLOs for two classes: interactive chat (<=200ms target) and batch reranking (<=800ms). Current test cluster: 8x A100-80GB equiv, single region (us-west). Representative prompts: customer account summary (avg 350 tokens), fraud reranking (top-10 candidate rerank, avg 80 tokens), chat assist (multi-turn, 20-40 tokens per turn). Key observations:
- Throughput: sustained 9.5k tokens/sec across cluster at steady state with batching and KV caching.
- Latency: p50 ~65ms for chat, p95 ~310-420ms depending on cold-cache and long-context requests.
- Cold-start: model warmup adds 180-320ms for first request after idle; exploring warm pool to mitigate.
- KV cache thrash for long-lived sessions when context >8k tokens; suggested session stickiness + sharded cache.
- Autoscale: burst policy worked but warm-up time for additional workers caused transient p95 degradation during sudden 3x traffic spikes. Suggested reserved headroom or immediate-burst capacity.
SLA negotiation points with procurement/legal: 99.95% uptime target, maintenance windows defined (monthly, pre-notified), throughput guarantees per-reserved-GPU (tokens/sec baseline + burst allowance), credits for SLA breaches. They want hard guarantees for market-open 5-minute spikes. Also requested a fallback routing policy to Redwood hosted API in case Dedicated pool saturates (must preserve data residency constraints).
poc_summary: Designed three-phase POC: 1) baseline functional validation (model correctness), 2) performance runs (load + soak + spike tests), 3) operational validation (failover, upgrades, monitoring). We completed phases 1-2; phase 3 scheduled after legal sign-off. Metric targets: interactive p95 <= 250ms (aspirational), contracted p95 <= 450ms; throughput >= 10k tokens/sec sustained with 20% burst capacity. Current cluster met throughput but marginal on interactive p95 during cold starts and long-context flows.
sla_requests: penalties: service credits tiered by minutes downtime
bench_results_summary: Load tests: 24h ramp to 10k tokens/sec with avg latency within target; soak: 72h with 2 transient incidents tied to autoscale warmup; spike tests (3x traffic) showed 20-25% p95 degradation without reserved burst capacity. Recommended reserved GPU plan: baseline 8 GPUs with 2-GPU burst pool or equivalent reserved burst; consider headroom for market-open spikes leading to +25% reserved capacity.
